parent_objective: design a fresh current-base surface refresh before another PPO continuation
blocked_by: M978 synthesis identifies moderate public-gate overfit risk after repeated optimization on established surfaces
invalidates: starting a new guarded PPO branch from M974 base before refreshing current-base proof surfaces

public_gates: M979 must not use private holdout
M979 must preserve P0 actor-input contract
M979 must design fresh current-base wrong-history and source-diverse surface mining
M979 must keep old public surfaces as retention gates, not the only discovery source
forbidden_shortcuts: do not start PPO from the new base before surface refresh
do not mine only the existing M267/M264 rows
do not treat surface refresh as driver promotion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_surface_refresh: fresh proof/preference surfaces around the new public base
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a no-PPO refresh to reduce public-row overfit risk before new PPO continuation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: surface-refresh design only; no training, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if design reuses only old public proof rows
stop if design cannot specify source diversity and acceptance thresholds
stop if design requires actor-input contract changes
fallback_plan: if fresh rows are sparse, design an expanded scenario/source mining step
if fresh rows are abundant, route to compact corpus export
if old surfaces disagree with fresh surfaces, route to overfit audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M978 pivots from exact-repair promotion to surface refresh before PPO

hypothesis: Before another guarded PPO continuation from the M974 public base, the project should refresh current-base wrong-history, preference, and source-diverse proof surfaces to reduce public-gate overfit risk.
success_criteria: design names the new public-gate base
design specifies fresh wrong-history boundary mining
design keeps PPO, promotion, and private holdout blocked
failure_criteria: design uses only old M267/M264 rows
decision_rule: M979 should only design the fresh surface refresh. It must route implementation to a separate milestone.
